local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

-- Configuração da Neblina
Lighting.FogEnd = 500
Lighting.FogStart = 50
Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)

-- Configuração da Chuva
local emitter = Workspace.WeatherSystem.Assets.RainAttachment.RainEmitter
emitter.Texture = "rbxassetid://243089317" -- Textura interna de chuva/partícula padrão
emitter.Rate = 50
emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 30)
emitter.VelocityInheritance = 0
emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.2)
emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.6)

-- Posicionamento da Chuva (ajuste simples sobre a base)
Workspace.WeatherSystem.Assets.RainAttachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
